scope: YouTube lists are complete and in order, and your account is shown correctly.

topics.title: Long YouTube lists
details: Search results, Home, History and other lists keep going. More videos load as you move down.
Page Down and Page Up move ten at a time. You can also say next page or previous page.
Filters work the same way. Every page of filtered results loads too.

topics.title: Subscriptions
details: Subscriptions now lists every channel you follow.
New from subscriptions has their newest videos.

topics.title: YouTube
details: History is in the right order again, newest first.
The menu says Sign out when you are signed in, and Sign in when you are not.
Short ages are said in words, such as 2 weeks ago.
Lists work the same with Chrome in the background.
